title: 14mm Male Red Eye Glass Cone Pull-Out w/ Leaf Handle Bowl
description: The 14mm Cone Pull-Out with Leaf Stamped Handle from Red Eye Glass includes a frosted base, an easy grip handle with a custom leaf design. Made of 100% high-grade borosilicate glass, this Pull-Out can last a lifetime with some basic care and maintenance.
